scope: All 100 item definitions and all 400 inherited targets were inventoried and assessed for verifiability. Undefined generic prices are not falsely reported as verified or silently replaced by an arbitrary shop quote.
priceConvention: Store dated advertised reference amounts in each local currency. Record the seller/plan/service/portion, exclude optional extras and delivery, and disclose separately added taxes. This is not a live national average or universal checkout total.
remainingGate: Before public launch as a factual retail-price game, resolve every non-reviewed region with an exact defensible scope and evidence, or make an explicit owner decision to launch Lowball as an estimate-based reference-price game.

observations.name: Nike Air Force 1
observations.finding: A CT2302-100 listing shows GBP109.99, while a different 'Low 07' SKU shows119.99. GBP110 is rounded and the item is under-specified; do not invent a single corrected price without selecting the SKU.

observations.name: Netflix Standard
observations.finding: The retrieved US Help Center shows Standard USD19.99/month before applicable taxes. This does not corroborate the other three countries.

observations.name: Disney+
observations.finding: Regional public extracts show Standard17.99 AUD,11.99 GBP and15.99 CAD; the UK page separates a temporary9.99 saver offer from11.99 regular monthly. US Standard is not an equivalent named plan.

observations.name: Nintendo Switch 2
observations.finding: Manufacturer revisions effective1 September2026 support769.95 AUD and499.99 USD console-only; the original AU699.95 launch announcement is obsolete. UK/CA remain open.

observations.name: iPhone 16
observations.finding: Apple regional extracts show128GB 'from'799 GBP and1149 CAD. The US799 starting quote includes carrier context; review unconditional unlocked pricing. Only the unambiguous AU1349 correction is integrated.

observations.name: PlayStation 5
observations.finding: Current manufacturer lists and April2026 changes identify current-generation disc/digital/Pro models separately. The game needs the exact1TB disc model and date; raw search price formatting drops cents, so no cent-level correction is inferred.
